title: Sincere thanks
content: Have recently had a family bereavement. This surgery could not have been more supportive both to my late relative before she passed away and to me in coping with my grief. Everyone from the receptionists to the GPs have been wonderful and I just want to pass on my sincere thanks for all the help i have received at this difficult time.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
